TRust Parley 0.11.1 correction

Source: crates.io parley 0.11.1, from the unchanged local Cargo registry
package. Upstream repository/revision is recorded in .cargo_vcs_info.json;
the original Apache-2.0 and MIT licenses are retained.

CSS Text 3 #boundary-shaping requires shaping through unchanged inline
formatting, regardless of DOM Text-node boundaries. ClusterData text_offset
formerly truncated a run-relative source byte offset to u16, wrapping text
ranges in contexts over 64 KiB. Store the offset as usize, matching the
source iterator and RunData text ranges. No font, shaping, or line-breaking
algorithm changes. Browser regression coverage lives in src/text/context.rs
and src/layout2/servo_regressions.rs.
